structuredContent.query: SELECT t.id, t.assigned_agent_id, a.nickname, t.status, t.process_activity_id, t.source_reference FROM agent_task t JOIN agent a ON a.id=t.assigned_agent_id WHERE t.status IN ("IN_PROGRESS","PENDING") AND a.agent_key IN ("customer-agent","meta-ad-approver") ORDER BY t.id DESC
